items.title: Poland says will create no-fly zone at Ukraine border after repeated airspace violations
items.description: Poland will soon create a no-fly zone near the Ukrainian border, a deputy defence minister announced on Wednesday, after several incursions into its airspace it blamed on Russia. Poland backs Ukraine as it fights off Russia's near five-year invasion and has repeatedly accused Moscow of seeking to target Kyiv's supporters with drone incursions and other methods. The no-fly zone is intended to allow Polish forces to quickly identify any Russian military aircraft and shoot them down if necessary. FRANCE 24's Selina Sykes reports.
